## About
Atlas Auto Body & Paint is a complete auto collision repair center in Richardson, serving drivers across the Metroplex. Our management team is the second generation in the collision repair industry, and customer satisfaction has always been our number one goal.
That is why referrals are the main way new customers find us. Neighbors who have been through a wreck send their friends our way, and many of them mention David and Reza by name.
We hold a 4.6 rating from 48 Google reviews. We are still at the same location, just with our office moved to the left corner unit.

## Services
- Collision repair and painting: Body and paint work after an accident, big or small, for domestic and import cars.
- Frame repair: Getting the structure of your car back where it belongs after a hard hit.
- Hail damage repair: Bring your car in after a hail storm and we will repair the damage.
- Paintless dent removal: Dent repair without repainting, when the job allows it.
- Suspension, air bag and air conditioning: Suspension, air bag and air conditioning repair alongside your body work.
- Auto glass: Glass repair and replacement as part of a complete collision repair.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work with my insurance company?
A: Yes. We work with all insurance companies, and you can call us with any questions about your claim.

Q: Will I have a car while mine is being repaired?
A: A free loan car is available. Give us a call to ask about it.

Q: Do you work on import cars?
A: Yes, we work on both domestic and import cars.

Q: What are your hours?
A: We are open Monday through Friday, 8 to 6, and closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: Did you move?
A: No. We are at the same location. We just moved our office to the left corner, unit 128.
